pilot_eligibility.selection: maximum native Student likelihood; ties choose earliest attempt

comparison: One score-ranked assignment per canonical family structure, same starts and numerical criteria. No global-maximum claim.
timing: Shared single-thread operation accounting, not independent direct wall-time speedup.
failure_policy: Every registered case retained; unresolved tables never screen; unresolved full fits retained as outcomes; qualified winners and best unqualified attained BIC reported separately.
seeds: Fresh fixed simulation seeds; no seed replacement or extension based on observed wins.
